newsitem.title: UK: Expeditors Intl opens first French offices.
newsitem.headline: Expeditors Intl opens first French offices.

text.p: Expeditors International of Washington Inc has opened its first four French offices in Paris, Lille, Lyon and Epinal.
The new French operations will be run by French country manager, Christophe Richard who is also Paris district manager, the Seattle-based company said in a statement.
Both he and the company's French sales manager, Laurent Bourcy, are based at Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport, it added.

"France is a unique market with specialised requirements and tremendous potential. Expeditors' customer base in France has grown substantially during the 14 years we've served the market," (via agents), added Michael Claydon, managing director, Europe.
District managers are Cathy Foulon in Lille, with Pascal Granger in Lyon and Nadine Maiseller in Epinal, the statement said. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
